title: Petition of over twenty (20) customers of Boston Edison Company, pursuant to M.G.L. c. 164, § 93, requesting the Department of Telecommunications and Energy to investigate the price of electricity sold and delivered by the Company to all customers in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, and to order a reduction in the price of electricity for all such customers, and a rebate of past excessive charges.
filings: Memorandum To: Secretary, Department of Public Utilities, From: William Stevens, Hearing Officer, Re: Hearing Officer's certification of Record to Department Secretary. submitted 6/15/98. DTE No. 98-14
